interface.longDescription: Production-oriented OMEGA release adding a formal Reality Filter Kernel connected to the Evidence Ledger, source-of-truth verification, Decision Trace Audit, Kratos security checks and Thor finalization. It separates observed/verified facts from inference/speculation/unknowns, isolates external prompt injection, audits unsupported absolute language and metacognitive claims, checks production-code completeness, records corrections and blocks DONE when required evidence or release gates are missing.
